Real Estate Sales Search
Jackson County provides you the ability to view certain online sales data and information regarding real estate property in the County contained in Certificates of Value that have been filed since January 1, 2007 .
NOTICE: The Recorder of Deeds office is now open to the public at the Truman Courthouse in Independence. Online Services are now available.
Certificate of Value
If you have any trouble locating a specific Certificate of Value filed within the date range listed above, contact our Taxpayer Assistance unit at 816-881-3530 or visit our staff in person at the Jackson County Courthouse in Kansas City.
Disclaimer
Any person using this data and information shall, and hereby does, knowingly accept this sales data information "as is," and Jackson County Missouri expressly disclaims any representation or warranty as to the completeness or accuracy of the same.
Further, the County expressly disclaims any representation or warranty that the data or information is current or as to the suitability of the data or information for any intended use. Any person using this data or information, expressly releases and agrees to hold the County, its officials and its employees, harmless from any and all claims or damages arising out of the use of the data or information, or whether or not it is complete or accurate or current; and expressly agrees to assume all risk for use and reliance on the data and information.
